title: Inside and outside covers
notes: First route: K-1 P1, then P3 to compare coarse and fine triangle covers; grades 2-3 and 4-5 P1-2, then one fine comparison in P3-4. On return, K-1 can choose a limited refinement (P2), alter a boundary (P4), or vary area with the same coarse markings (P5-6). Grades 2-3 can test on the trapezoid whether refining always halves the gap (P5) and build counterexamples to exact-area claims (P6-7). Grades 4-5 can optimize the refinement budget (P5), justify monotonicity (P6) and find the trapezoid's exact area between its bounds (P7). Four small squares retain one big-square area unit.

0-5 running around; 5-9 launch with the tiles and the three sample cells; 9-27 coarse covers; 27-47 refine or change a shape; 47-55 compare certificates and counterexamples; 55-60 reset. One sound before-and-after cover is enough for a useful session.
